prompt:
A sprite sheet of 6 separate props for a top-down pixel-art JRPG, drawn from the classic 3/4 top-down RPG angle (you see the top surface and the front face; objects stand upright, feet/base at the bottom). Arrange them in a 2 x 3 grid in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), with wide empty space between them; every prop is fully separate, none touching or overlapping, nothing cut off by the image edge. The props, in order: 1) a harbour way-lamp of a white island port town: a short square pillar of WHITEWASHED stone blocks with a pale blue band, on top a brass-framed SHIP'S LANTERN with glass panes, UNLIT (dark glass); 2) the SAME whitewashed pillar harbour lamp LIT: the ship's lantern glass glowing warm yellow; 3) a standing signpost of the islands: a post of grey sea-bleached DRIFTWOOD with a whitewashed plank board nailed across it (blank board, no letters), a coil of old rope and two small shells at its foot; 4) a small ship's LANTERN of brass and glass standing on the ground, with a ring handle (unlit, dark glass); 5) a notice board of a harbour town: a wide whitewashed wooden board on two driftwood posts with a small blue roof, a few blank papers pinned to it (no letters); 6) the SAME small brass ship's lantern LIT, its glass glowing warm yellow.
Scale: the way-lamp is about 50 art pixels tall, the signpost about 24 art pixels tall, the small lantern about 12 art pixels tall, the notice board about 30 art pixels wide; each art pixel is about 6x6 image pixels. Items 1 and 2 must be identical in size, shape and colours except that 2 is lit; items 4 and 6 likewise.
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Exception: in the lit variants the glass may be bright, but no light spills onto anything around them.
Background: fully transparent. No ground under the props, no drop shadows, no text, no labels, no numbers.
revised_prompt: Create a transparent-background sprite sheet with SIX completely isolated top-down 3/4-view JRPG pixel-art props, arranged in 2 COLUMNS x 3 ROWS, reading left to right, top to bottom. Lots of transparent empty spacing around all items, no touching, cropping, ground, shadows, text, labels, or numbers. Each object upright, top and front visible, base at bottom. Row 1: (left) harbour way-lamp, short square pillar of WHITEWASHED stone blocks with pale blue band, topped by brass-framed ship lantern with DARK UNLIT glass; (right) EXACT SAME pillar lamp, identical silhouette dimensions and material colors, except lantern panes are bright warm yellow LIT glass, WITHOUT bloom or light spill. Row 2: (left) grey sea-bleached driftwood upright signpost with blank whitewashed plank nailed horizontally, coil of aged rope and two little seashells at foot; (right) small brass framed ship's lantern on ground with ring handle, dark UNLIT glass. Row 3: (left) harbor-town noticeboard, wide whitewashed wooden board on TWO driftwood legs under a little BLUE ROOF, several pinned BLANK papers; (right) EXACT SAME small lantern as row 2 right, identical size, silhouette, brass coloring, except panes bright warm yellow LIT, no bloom or spill. Maintain consistent scale: pillar lamps ~50 source-art pixels tall; signpost ~24; small lanterns ~12; noticeboard ~30 pixels wide. Each source-art pixel a uniform sharp square ~6-8 output pixels wide. PREMIUM modern hi-bit hand-placed pixel art with cohesive crisp square pixels and deliberate 3-10-pixel clusters; no anti-alias, blur, soft brushes, smooth gradients, photographic texture, noise, checkerboard dithering. Hue shifted ramps, 4-6 shades per material, purple-red more saturated shadows and warm yellow highlights, earthy worn coastal atmosphere. Neutral even overcast upper-left lighting throughout, no cast shadows, night darkness, glow, halos, light pools or vignette. Alpha fully transparent background.
